notes.title: Big Bumper Balance B-update
notes.notes:
It's been quite the busy week, right? The coverage embargo for Isle of Swaps ended on September 19th, so that's why there's been lots of videos since then. Thanks to all the new people who have discovered, followed and wishlisted the game! 

Another cheeky benefit is that watching other people play reveals lots of issues for the game that need to be fixed so here's a big list of all the changes I've done. Thankfully there hasn't been a lot of bugs and most of them were issues that weren't even spotted.
If you've played the full game already, this is an update since then (v1.032>v1.034) and if you've only played the demo then this is a huge update as the demo was last updated in June!

[h2]Card changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hangolin ability changed to gain 1 thorns on energy gain
[*]Lepivice stats lowered
[*]Shampoise changed from 6 pow 2 def to 7 pow 1 def
[*]Trilodril Thorns on hit increased from 4 to 5
[*]Solol ability changed from burning attacker to burning all enemies
[*]Obaraboil ability changed to Gaining Energy: All enemies gain 2 burn
[*]Ursignal shock on hit increased from 1 to 3 shock
[*]Effluvark ability changed to On Hit: Attacker gain 2 burn

[*]Thorny Vines increased to 2 energy. Power increased from Thorns to Thorns +2. Now consumes half your thorns on use.
[*]Blossom Dance reduced from Defence+2 Heal to Defence Heal
[*]Gift of Thorns and Balance changed to require 1 neutral energy
[*]Dodge Spot and Immunity spot changed to be every turn but now cost 3 energy
[*]Bramble Patch reduced from a 2 thorn spot to 1 thorn spot
[*]Kaboom changed to inflict 5 burn to opposite for 1 energy
[*]Wild Fire damage reduced from 4 to 3
[*]Meteor changed to inflicting true damage to everyone, inflicting burn removed
[*]Drought energy cost reduced from 3 to 2
[*]Short circuit reduced from def+3 shock to def shock
[*]Shock puddles increased from a 1 shock spot to 2 shock spot
[*]Bob and Weave damage increased from 6 to 8
[*]Ground changed to stun on 3+ shock to 6+ shock
[*]Overgrowth damage reduced from 8 to 6

[*]Grabby Hand changed from +1 card plays, [*]2 critter power to +1 card plays, [*]2 card draws each turn
[*]Large Sword reduced from 3 power to 2 power to be in line with large shield
[*]Drill reduced from 3 pierce to 2 pierce
[*]Volcano reduced from 5 damage to 3
[/list]

[h2]Game Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Dotty's ability now doubles the 1st card of her turn instead of the 3rd
[*]Enemies now move at the end of their turn instead of at the start
[*]Increased Enemy HP slighty. From 1 to 2 per level and 3 to 4 if its their level up bonus
[*]Reduced the number of common energy cards enemies will take into battle from 3 to 1
[*]Buffed the bosses battle teams. Each will now have 3 critters in act 1 (but a reduced enemy level) and most act 2s now have evolved critters
[*]Trainers in Randomisers will now have an equal number of critters to what they'd usually have
[*]There's an increased chance of running into Special Characters you don't have the achievement for yet.
[*]Completing a standard challenge run unlocks Nuzlocke, completing Nuzlocke unlocks randomiser
[*]Championships round 2 and 3 should now be a bit tougher as enemies will be level 7 and 8 respectively
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*]Marshall's SP will now reflect how much SP he actually has instead of 35
[*]Hybrid Critters now correctly display they have [*]6 resistances
[*]Fixed the Energetic x cards not  consuming energy
[*]Fixed Perk Up not working properly
[*]Fixed Kinecoo Hybrid having a broken card
[*]Fixed a critter's power/defence value not changing if the power/defence change was removed by Reset
[*]Fixed Rainbow activating every turn
[*]Unmastered packs cant be gotten in nuzlocke/rando nuzlocke anymore as a very specific instance crashes the game
[*]Losing Critters vs the Act 3 Boss will no longer take away lives. Its frustrating to win a run but then lose on a technicality
[*]Fixed Team Rockoon running off and not swapping if you beat them but lose a critter in a nuzlocke run
[*]Fixed the explosion SFX of Team Rockoon not following the set sfx volume
[*]Fixed Imakooky's Randomander so that its new stats adhere to any power/defence changes it has
[*]Fixed Imakooky's Randomander to keep the same percentage of health when it changes stats every turn
[*]Fixed nuzlocke not removing unusuable cards when a critter faints in battle
[*]Fixed randomiser removing skill cards when a critter faints in battle (As anyone can use them)
[*]Maybe fixed the options menu breaking when you mash Escape
[*]Fixed the damage numbers in battle not being over the critters in wide screen resolutions
[*]Improved how the binder looks in widescreen and more square resolutions
[*]The binder wasn't showing the quantities of your cards [*] battle deck cards if you swapped without opening the battle deck first. Fixed.
[*]Fixed the master binder filter not working
[/list]

And just a reminder that its only a few days left until Isle of Swaps releases on the 27th September! So wishlist and be ready for the launch. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swap

notes.title: v.0.12 Patch notes for next fest
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, done a bit of work over the last week getting the last few finishing touches and polish into the game. Here's the notes

[h2]Headlines![/h2]
[list]
[*] The game is now fully translated into Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese!
[*] Trading has been reworked so its easy to see all cards, and all selected cards, at once.
[/list]

[h2]Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the coin bonus for unflipped cards, increased coins from winning battles
[*] Removed 'Doesnt use a card play' from the Critter/Element energy cards, Double Critter Energy and Triple Rainbow Energy (the rare ones)
[*] Any Critter added to the battle deck requires 6 skill cards, removing needing only 3 skill cards if a critter of that element is already in the deck
[*] Basic attack cards reverted to no longer give energy
[*] When editing the battle deck, the quantity of cards will increase and decrease as they're added/removed from the deck
[*] The same applies to trading
[*] When trading the value on the card now updates to its actual value in the trade, instead of its base value from its rarity
[*] Wild Critter battles will now have additional critters in act 2 and 3, though you'll still only get the Critter shown on the map
[*] Trainers in Act 1 will increase in power 50% of the way through, instead of 66%
[*] Special Trainers and the Boss in Act 1 will now use 3 skill cards per turn instead of 2
[*] Critters will now jump around when using skills
[/list]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Heal Booster reduced from +2 to heals to +1 to heals
[*] Drill increased from ignoring 2 defence to 4
[*] All Aqua cards have their inflicted soak lowered
[*] Quick Shock increased from 2 to 4 shock
[*] Baaroola heal on hit reduced from 3 to 2
[*] Corydusty stats changed. Normal Hp-2(42), Def +1 (5). Hybrid HP -2(38), Def +1(4)
[*] Moltin Ability changed from every 3 turns, to battle start/5th turn
[*] Solol Hybrid HP-2(30) Def+1(4) 
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the tooltips in battle not appearing near the mouse when in anything other than 1920x1080
[*] Fixed the critters you get offered in swaps not being affected by your rarity chance
[*] Fixed stickers that increase hand size
[*] Fixed the skill cards that have a secondary element of Rainbow to be used by everyone.
[*] Fixed the rival not using his starters evolutions in act 2 onwards (demo only issue)
[*] Fixed the battle deck removing the first instance of a skill/sticker card instead of the one clicked
[*] Hopefully fixed the issue where the hand cards dont snap to the critter when dragged
[*] Fixed not having skill cards removed in battle when no one could use them
[*] Fixed Critters being able to attack once defeated by shock
[*] Fixed hand cards not resetting their text if you cancel choosing energy for them
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.093: Choose Your Energy
notes.notes:
I've been watching how people have been playing the game and something that's been coming up is the ability to pick the energy that the cards use.
Previously, with the game automatically picking the energy to use for cards, you could be unable to play all the cards you wanted, even if you had the energy at the start of the turn. And that kinda sucks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/df16abec244520352c56ea1e46b97763d980e3a0.png[/img]
So I've added a little system to choose which energy you want to use, and if you don't want to bother, it's a new option in the game options! Along with that, you can now skip the binder page turning animation and enable buttons in addition to the click+drag gestures for the binder/booster packs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/f0e6b8a0c1ccdbeb3d1c4e2480474b5e4706c88c.png[/img]
Another big change expands the decks you can make with a change to the hybrid Skill Cards. These cards require 2 elements of energy to use and generally have effects from both of the types but could only be used by 1 of those types of Critter. No longer! Hybrid Skill Cards can now be used by Critters of both types! Its an idea I've been thinking on for a while and I want to give it a try, it should give loads more options to play with.

Something that's also come up a few times is dragging a skill card onto a Critter seeming finnicky. So now the Skill Card snaps over the Critter to make it much clearer when its in the right place to play.

[b]
Hows the full game coming along?[/b]
For the full game, the main systems are almost done! You can master cards, unlock new characters, enter the Critter Championship and I've made 90 more Skill Cards to try out. Considering the demo has 100 Skill Cards, thats quite the boost! I hope they work out and allow for some great play styles.

Now what are you waiting for, go try out the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swaps

notes.title: Demo update: The Rival and Sami Swaps have entered the playground
notes.notes:
Hi there swappers, the demo is updated once again and this one brings some new characters and features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/c46bb570da9f518bc5811e18042f7ed32deec762.png[/img]
First up is the Rival character and Sami Swaps.
[b]The Rival [/b]embodies a set of Special Characters, like Team Rockoon, and other characters who are more unique than the generic trainers you'll usually face. These guys are generally tougher to impose a miniboss sort of challenge and will offer better cards to swap when beaten. 
The Rival will take the Critter who is strong vs the one you choose at the start of the run and will appear in the very first hand. If you can beat him, your run will be off to a great start. From there, he appears in the second half of each act with a team featuring his starter and some other Critters he picked up along the way!

[b]Sami Swaps[/b] isn't much for battling, he's all about those trades. Sami will place 3 individual swaps of cards that are just sat in your binder and offer an equal or better rarity of cards. You aren't using those cards, so it's totally worth swapping with him, right?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43570059/6dbc3d83fe1bf4f5fa0dee71cfd197bcd9c2f956.png[/img]
The shop has gotten its shipment of a [b]Signature Machine![/b] You know how you get a skill card when you beat a Wild Critter? That's its Signature Skill and this machine will sell you the Signature Skill of any Critter you have in your binder.

Want the tailnotes of the other new features?
[list]
[*] Trainers will now ask for a certain type of card when you swap with them, putting this in the swap increases your swap value and lets you get good deals.
[*] Swapmaster Dina's ability gives her an additional 1 Swap Value for each card she offers.
[*] Skill Cards you can't use because the only Critter that could use them has fainted are now removed from that battle. This is to lower the frustration of unusable cards in battle.
[*] Losing a battle only costs a single Critter instead of all the ones you used.
[*] Stickers start at 10 slots and decrease based on the rarity of the Critters you use. Use less Critters to use more Stickers
[*] Using Critters of the same type in your Battle Deck lowers how many Skill Cards you need to add from 6 to 3 making it easier to use duplicate types.
[/list]

Can I expect survival against your Rival? Head into the demo and find out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2294160/Isle_of_Swap

notes.title: The Huge demo update patch notes!
notes.notes:
It's been just over a month since the demo launched and I've been beavering away in that time improving the game based on what you've been saying. To see the broad strokes, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2294160/view/3726223344811649916]click here to see the main changes to this update.[/url]

Here's the full list in the detailed bullet point format

[h3]GAME UPDATES[/h3]
[list]
[*] -Each Critter adds no skill cards to the deck
[*] -Winning a Wild Critter fight gives both the Critter and a Skill Card (a skill card that wouldve been attached to them)
[*] -NPCs now offer more cards for swapping
[*] -NPCs now have at least 1 skill card of each type so they'll always have something you may want
[*] -NPCs will always offer a common/uncommon of each type with a chance of an additional rare
[*] -The Battle deck now requires you to add 6 skill cards for each Critter you add (1=6 deck cards total/ 2=12 deck cards total/ 3=18 deck cards total)
[*] -Stickers are now given their own slots starting at 8 stickers and reducing based upon the rarity of critters you're using 
[*] -The player now starts with 3 copies of each energy and attack card. Assuming 2 is the most a player would usually need, this frees up more swapping fodder
[*] -The Enerttack Pak has been added to Booster Machines which contain energy cards and the basic attack cards
[*] -With the addition of the Enerttack Pak, energy and basic attack cards have been removed from the regular booster pack
[*] -Uncommon cards are now worth 2 (Swap Value/Money), Rare cards are now worth 6 (Swap Value/Money)
[*] -Heal, Burn, Poison, Shock, Soak are now affected by the Critters Defence
[*] -Except on common cards where it remains a static value
[*] -Status effects based on turns like power/defence up/down, taunt, stun/dodge/immunity etc are unaffected
[*] -The aim of this is to make defensive Critters more useful in battle as they become more proficient at healing and using status effects
[*] -Power and Defence changes are now on a sliding scale of -3 to +3 and all those buffs/debuffs last 3 turns
[*] -Instead of the length of power/defence up/down, the cards now change in intensity
[*] -Cards from your hand update their text when hovering them over a Critter to show how much damage or status effect will be done
[*] -Cards that the enemy will use will always show these updated numbers
[*] -Burn damage no longer spreads on reaching 5 burn
[*] -Reduced Soak damage from 2 to 1
[*] -Additional description of Stickers on the Stickers page of the battle deck
[*] -Removed the Swap buttons on the overworld. Pointless
[*] -The wild Critters you find are now properly based on the progress through act. No more wild Rares in act 1.
[*] -The Trainers will now use their battle team from the next act if you're using more Critters than they are to bump up the challenge.
[*] -The starter deck now has an additional skill card that generates energy+does an effect in it.
[*] -Each element type now only has 2 weaknesses to make it easier to counterpick trainers
[*] -Opponents now have a certain type of card they want and your swap value will be boosted if you offer those to them
[*] -Dina's ability now works. She gains +1 Swap value on every card swapped. Wow!
[*] -Enemies now use more skill cards in Act 2 and 3 so the game should be a bit tougher
[*] -Having a critter get defeated now removes all skill cards of its element from the battle (if its the only one left of that type)
[*] -This can lead to a very specific situation where all skill cards are removed, and the player just loses in this scenario
[*] -Losing a battle now only takes 1 critter card and a life from you instead of all critters.
[*] -The binder contents buttons now skip to the first card you own from that category (if you own a card in that category)
[*] -The battle deck can now be viewed and edited whilst swapping
[*] -There are now 10 sticker slots. Commons reduce it by 1, uncommon by 2, rares by 3. Players using 1 or 2 Critters should get more Stickers, right?
[*] -Spot effects now stack
[*] -The battle deck now orders the cards based on elements
[*] -Buttons now have text on them for clarity
[/list]

[h3]CRITTER UPDATES[/h3]
[list]
[*] -Striqual HP reduced from 40 to 30. Ability changed from On hit:+1 Power to On Attack: +1 Power
[*] -Zappen ability changed from 2 to 1 dodge in line with dodge having a 1 stack max
[*] -Hangolin reduced from 3 Thorns to 2 Thorns
[*] -Aguatto is now 5 Pow 1 Def from 4 Pow 2 Def
[*] -Aguatto starts with Moat instead of Water Shield
[*] -Alerte gains 4 Taunt on Battle Start
[*] -Alertle now has 34HP, 2 Power, 2 Defence
[*] -Fledgee now gains 1 Status Immunity every 3 Turns
[*] -Fledgee now has 32HP, 3 Power, 2 Defence
[*] -Kinecoo changed to 38HP, 6 Pow, 0 Def and a new ability to get 1 Status Immunity every turn
[/list]

[h3]SKILL UPDATES[/h3]
[list]
[*] -Made sure cards only gave 1 stun/dodge/status immunity
[*] -Tsunami and Mind Blast have had their damage lowered as theyre AoE skills
[*] -Thunderstorm damage reduced to 5, one neutral energy added to energy cost
[*] -Meteor has had damage lowered as its also AoE but now also gives 1 Burn to all enemies
[*] -Terra Attack now correctly set to Power + 4 Damage (was +3)
[*] -Stunning Zap now does Power +0 damage to all enemies in addition to stunning all enemies and now costs 4 energy
[*] -Taunt reduced from 3 turns of Taunt to 2
[*] -Soak Spot Soak each turn reduced from 2 to 1
[*] -Power Up Whack reduced from 2 Power Up to 1
[*] -Drench reduced from 2 Defence Down to 1
[*] -Burn Up reduced from 2 Power Up to 1
[*] -Heal Spot reduced from 5HP per turn to 3HP
[*] -Big Hit energy increased from 3 to 4
[*] -Wildfire energy cost increased from 2 to 3
[*] -Reverted the change to the basic attacks damage. All of those are +1 damage
[*] -Moat changed from Allies to All Allies, Heal reduced to Def+1
[*] -Healing Drink now heals All Allies and for 2HP instead of 3HP
[*] -Rescue now affects All Allies
[*] -Take Root now deals Poison and Shock to all enemies for nature/volt/any/any energy
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] -Fixed a bug where the top card of the swap pile would be replaced with the equipped skill card
[*] -You can no longer swap with characters who dont have any cards left to swap
[*] -Fixed cards where the attack was listed second not working properly
[*] -Fixed cards that hit twice (barrage/geode smash) not working properly
[*] -Aqua Attack is properly increased by power
[*] -Heat Rash properly applies damage based on power and burn based on defence
[*] -Fixed swapped hand cards having a deep sfx and the swap sfx being really deep on them
[*] -Fixed power and defence changes not wearing off properly
[*] -Fixed the Battle UI elements flying away if the button was spammed making them shake around
[/list]

notes.title: v0.083 update
notes.notes:
-Overworld
Fixed the buttons in the binder not always going to the right page and made sure the swipe arrows updated when those buttons were clicked.
Added a page number to the binder.
Shop has been reworked to now sell a selection of cards instead of duplicates
Booster pack price reduced from 8 to 6.
Act 2 has been shortened from 36 cards to 27
The tutorial starts with 5 of each elemental attack too. just makes the binder look nicer

-Battles
Battles now give 2 money instead of 10
+2 Enemies will now use 3 cards per turn instead of 2
Fixed cards that do damage + an effect having the effect trigger before the damage (obvious with soak)

Changed Joke Buzzer from Stun on Hit to Stun opposite every 3 turns

notes.title: v0.081 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Stickers are here! You'll be able to get them in Booster packs and swapping after fights. As the enemy gets stronger you'll equip stickers to increase your strength to match. The aim is you should be able to finish the 2 acts the demo run offers.

[*]The Binder now has easy skip buttons to jump to different pages. I wouldn't want you to mouse swipe 12 times just to get to your new stickers.

[*] More card art, only a few left to do
[*] True Damage is now activated properly (Basically only Staraphims ability right now)
[*] Starrite ability changed to give Taunt on hit instead of Stun
[*] Soak now reduces when triggered
[*] Battle Start abilities will only trigger when all the cards are on the field
[*] Power Up now properly increases damage
[/list]
